reason: I already DM local creators myself and pay them with a free meal or a couple hundred bucks on Venmo, and that works fine for a cafe my size. A $500 Reel plus a fee is more than I spend on a post now, and I don't need a platform in the middle of a DM I can send myself.
objection: The follower counts and results are whatever the creator says they are, so I'd still be guessing whether a post brings people through my door or just gets likes from people three states away.
would_change_my_mind: Verified local audience numbers and promo-code results from other cafes in my city showing real redemptions, plus creators under $200 so it fits what I already spend.
